domain: Semantic Change Detection with Mixture of Experts

research_hypotheses.hypothesis: Injecting class labels directly to the MoE router (Semantic Routing) yields better expert specialization than routing based on latent features alone (Dynamic Routing).
research_hypotheses.status: Tested - Showed marginal difference (F1: 0.5470 vs 0.5469). Root cause: Class imbalance (80% low_veg) overwhelms load-balancing loss.

research_hypotheses.hypothesis: GNN layer (GraphSAGE with hybrid spatial-spectral weights) captures local geographic and feature adjacency better than flat token Transformer reasoning.

open_research_questions: How to mitigate class imbalance in MoE routing without causing expert collapse (e.g. class-weighted routing, unbalanced routing, Top-2 without rebalancing)?
How would performance scale if trained for more than 30 epochs?
Evaluation of the best semantic model on the full 1,694 test pairs.
